Privacy Policy

Last Updated: June 2026

Introduction

WeSearchAI (“we,” “us,” or “our”) operates the WeSearchAI website. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website.

Please read this privacy policy carefully. If you do not agree with our policies and practices, please do not use our site.

Information We Collect

Information You Provide Directly

  • Comments and Feedback: When you leave comments or contact us
  • Email Subscriptions: When you subscribe to our RSS feed or newsletter
  • Contact Forms: Any information submitted through contact forms

Information Collected Automatically

  • Log Data: IP address, browser type, pages visited, time spent on pages
  • Cookies: Small files stored on your device for functionality and analytics
  • Device Information: Device type, operating system, unique identifiers

Third-Party Information

  • Google Analytics: Traffic and behavior analytics
  • Google AdSense: Advertising-related data
  • Social Media: If you interact through social platforms

How We Use Your Information

We use collected information for:

  • Site improvement and optimization
  • Personalizing user experience
  • Analyzing site traffic and performance
  • Sending newsletters (if subscribed)
  • Responding to inquiries
  • Complying with legal obligations

Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies for:

  • Website functionality
  • User preferences
  • Analytics and traffic monitoring
  • Advertising personalization

You can control cookies through browser settings. Disabling cookies may limit site functionality.

Third-Party Services

Google Analytics

Google collects data about site usage. See Google’s Privacy Policy.

Google AdSense

AdSense uses cookies for interest-based advertising. See Google’s Privacy Policy.

Advertising & Opt-out

We may work with advertising partners (including Google) to serve ads on the site. These partners may use cookies, web beacons, and similar technologies to collect information about your visits to this and other websites to provide personalized advertising. To learn how Google uses data when you use our partners’ sites or apps, see: https://www.google.com/policies/technologies/ads/

If you want to opt out of personalized advertising from Google, you can visit Google Ads Settings: https://adssettings.google.com/ (this does not opt you out of seeing ads, only personalization). For other advertising partners, please refer to their own privacy pages and opt-out tools.

Third-Party Links

Our site may contain links to external websites. We are not responsible for external sites’ privacy practices.

Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your information. However, no internet transmission is completely secure.

Children’s Privacy

Our site is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.

Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have rights to:

  • Access your personal data
  • Correct inaccurate data
  • Request data deletion
  • Opt-out of marketing communications

Contact Us

For privacy concerns or questions, contact us at:

Email: info@wesearchai.com

Changes to Policy

We may update this policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or applicable law. When we make material changes we will post a notice on this page with the “Last Updated” date. Continued use of the site after changes indicates acceptance of the updated policy.

Legal Rights and International Visitors

If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA), the United Kingdom, or other jurisdictions with similar laws, you have rights under data protection laws such as the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). These rights may include:

  • The right to access the personal data we hold about you.
  • The right to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
  • The right to request deletion (the “right to be forgotten”).
  • The right to restrict or object to certain processing, including profiling.
  • The right to portability of your data to another service provider.

For California residents, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) provide rights including:

  • The right to know the categories of personal information we collect and the purposes for which we use it.
  • The right to request deletion of personal information collected about you.
  • The right to opt-out of the sale or sharing of personal information (to the extent applicable).
  • The right to non-discrimination for exercising your privacy rights.

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at the address below with “Privacy Request” in the subject. We will respond in accordance with applicable law.

Data Controller and Contact

WeSearchAI is the data controller for personal data processed through this website. To make privacy requests or ask questions about this policy, contact:

Email: info@wesearchai.com

If you are in the EU/EEA and wish to contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO) or designated representative, please email the address above and include your country and request details.

External Resources

This policy references and follows principles described by recognised authorities and guidance, including:

  • Google Publisher & AdSense policies: https://support.google.com/adsense/
  • GDPR guidance: https://gdpr.eu/
  • California privacy (CCPA/CPRA): https://oag.ca.gov/privacy/ccpa

This policy does not constitute legal advice. If you require legal advice about privacy compliance, consult a qualified attorney.
